<div class="jd-toast" id="success-toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"><button class="jd-toast-close" type="button" id="toast-close" aria-label="Close">├ù</button><strong>πâÇπéªπâ│πâ¡πâ╝πâëπéÆΘûïσºïπüùπü╛πüÖ</strong><p>πüöσàÑσè¢πüéπéèπüîπü¿πüåπüöπüûπüäπü╛πüÖπÇéΦ│çµûÖπü«πâÇπéªπâ│πâ¡πâ╝πâëπéÆΘûïσºïπüùπü╛πüùπüƒπÇé</p></div>

<script>
(function(){
  const form=document.getElementById('download-form');
  const toast=document.getElementById('success-toast');
  const close=document.getElementById('toast-close');
  const btn=form.querySelector('.jd-submit');
  const PDF_DATA="data:application/pdf;base64,";
  function setError(name,on){
    const field=form.querySelector('[data-field="'+name+'"]');
    field.classList.toggle('is-error',on);
    const input=field.querySelector('input');
    input.setAttribute('aria-invalid',on?'true':'false');
  }
  function validEmail(v){return /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/.test(v)}
  form.addEventListener('submit',function(e){
    e.preventDefault();
    const company=form.company.value.trim();
    const email=form.email.value.trim();
    const business=form.business.value.trim();
    setError('company',!company); setError('email',!validEmail(email)); setError('business',!business);
    if(!company||!validEmail(email)||!business){
      const first=form.querySelector('.is-error input'); if(first) first.focus(); return;
    }
    btn.disabled=true;
    setTimeout(function(){
      const a=document.createElement('a');
      a.href=PDF_DATA;
      a.download='JobShare_Business_Service_Guide_SAMPLE.pdf';
      document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove();
      toast.classList.add('is-show'); btn.disabled=false;
      setTimeout(()=>toast.classList.remove('is-show'),5000);
    },280);
  });
  form.querySelectorAll('input').forEach(function(input){input.addEventListener('input',function(){input.closest('.jd-field').classList.remove('is-error');input.removeAttribute('aria-invalid')})});
  close.addEventListener('click',()=>toast.classList.remove('is-show'));
})();
</script>
